Compute directly:
(u+4)(u-1) = u² + 3u - 4
(u-3)(u+6) = u² + 3u - 18
Difference: (u² + 3u - 4) - (u² + 3u - 18) = 14.

Both solutions are wrong. Solution A makes sign errors when distributing the subtraction (it gets -6u - 3u rather than -(6u) + 3u... and the constants -4 - 18 instead of -4 + 18). Solution B expands correctly but then makes a sign error on the subtraction, writing -3u - 18 instead of -3u + 18, and gets -22 instead of 14.

Neither reaches the correct answer, 14. Which is closer? Solution B's expansion is correct and its error is only a single sign slip on the constant, with the u terms cancelling properly. Solution A has multiple errors and leaves a spurious u term, so B is more likely the better of the two.

WINNER: B
